def assert_available(platform: str | None = None) -> None: """Refuse, naming the failed probe, if the tile path cannot run here.
THE ONLY REFUSAL LEFT ON THIS AXIS. There used to be three tiers and a router, and the router's job was to pick a lesser transport when this probe failed; the lesser transports are gone (see ``file_io.slab_io``'s module docstring), so a failed probe is now a plain "this deployment cannot do the thing" and says which part.
Nothing here is about process count. The old refusals all keyed on ``process_count() > 1`` because the tier they guarded was legal at exactly one process; this one is not legal-at-P=1-only, it is the only path there is, so it either works or the deployment is broken.
